create_fp8_quant_key: create an FP8 quantization key with specified static/dynamic mode, group shape, and symmetry
quantize_weights: quantize a weight tensor using a given scalar type and optional group size with zero points
gptq_quantize_weights: quantize weights using GPTQ algorithm with optional activation ordering and test permutation
scaled_quantize: quantize a 2D tensor to a target dtype using per-group scaling with block reshaping
scaled_dequantize: dequantize a quantized tensor back to floating point using group broadcasted scales
